findings.title: Overlapping paint modifier masks fail to remove an inherited modifier
findings.evidence: apply_paint_modifiers passes add.difference(remove) and remove.difference(add), dropping an overlapping bit from both operations. With lower BOLD and public Style { add_modifier: BOLD, sub_modifier: BOLD }, underlay preserves BOLD while canonical ordinary fill removes it. The unchanged prior overlap test passes only because its base has no BOLD. New public Runtime full-buffer test overlapping_modifier_fields_remove_inherited_bold passes on exact860 and fails on5ac.
findings.repair: Model Ratatui removal precedence even for inherited bits; remove must retain overlapping bits. Keep the distinct explicit StylePatch addition precedence and test successive operations against canonical painting.

findings.title: Single deferred fade loses sequential paint semantics
findings.evidence: defer_fade overwrites the previous operation, and composite evaluates its background/REVERSED guard after all subsequent paints. Three public Runtime differential tests pass on exact860 and fail on5ac: repeated_rgb_fades_compose_in_order (only the last RGB fade is applied), later_background_does_not_undo_earlier_fade (background-only paint retrospectively removes the prior DIM), and later_reverse_does_not_undo_earlier_fade (REVERSED retrospectively prevents the prior DIM). These are ordinary supported painter calls; no application/test identity is involved.
findings.repair: Preserve ordered fade transforms and their guards relative to subsequent background/modifier/channel changes in the existing compositor pipeline. Resolve inherited channels against actual lower layers, without materializing stale page colors. Add all three unchanged public differentials plus fade-then-remove-DIM and explicit foreground/patch interactions.

fixed_prior_findings: Original BB-R1/R2/R3 fixtures all now pass on5ac: simple post-fill fade, overlap with no inherited modifier, and right-aligned vacated-source reset. This is bounded repair evidence, not full closure of the broader operation contracts.

Strong actual-admitted upper-layer test, underline retention, role-aware modal dim comparison across four color levels, page ForcedWidth reset, and20 clipped/zero/wide page cases remain passing. Original ignored-Tick weak nested fixture is retained only as historical control; it is never credited as actual upper-layer admission.
